title: Invisible Item Frame Textures!
description: Adds a texture to invisible item frames (in inventory)
body:
# Invisible Item Frame (Items)!

This is for those who use invisible item frames! This gives the item frames with the enitiy tag "Invisible" an **unique** texture to diffrenciate from a normal and invisible item frame!
⠀
⠀





⠀

The command to get Invisible Item Frames ⮯ ⮯

/give @p item_frame[minecraft:entity_data={id:"minecraft:item_frame",Invisible:1b}]

### Made by [**MannyQUESO**](https://www.youtube.com/@MannyQUESO)
